      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored in E.164 form; a leading
            '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed
            and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+()\-\s]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Write-only create directive. When true, permits creating this owner even
            though another owner already has the same lastName and address (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace); otherwise such a request is rejected.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'

          properties:

              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:

              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.

## Summary

I implemented the `sharesHousehold` / `householdId` feature on `POST /api/owners`, following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions.

**Behavior:** When a create request has the same lastName+address (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) as an existing owner:
- Without `sharesHousehold: true` → rejected 409 (existing behavior, unchanged).
- With `sharesHousehold: true` → allowed, and both the new owner and the matched existing owner(s) are stamped with the same `householdId` — a stable identifier deterministically derived from the canonical lastName+address, so every owner joining that household gets the identical value. `householdId` is returned in the owner representation.

**Changes:**
- `openapi.yml` — added read-only `householdId` to the `Owner` response schema (drives the generated `OwnerDto`).
- `model/Owner.java` — added the persistent `householdId` field (`household_id` column) with getter/setter.
- `db/{hsqldb,h2,postgres,mysql}/schema.sql` — added the `household_id` column to the `owners` table.
- `mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — ignore `householdId` when mapping the request fields DTO (it's pipeline-assigned; MapStruct maps it automatically on the response side).
- `function/owner/EnsureUniqueHousehold.java` — now, on a match with sharing opted in, derives the shared id, stamps/saves the matching existing owner(s), and publishes it via `Out<HouseholdId>`; still throws `DuplicateHouseholdException` when sharing is not requested.
- `function/owner/HouseholdId.java` (new) — a dedicated variable type so OfficeFloor's by-type matching stays unambiguous.
- `function/owner/AssignHousehold.java` (new) — stamps the shared id onto the newly built owner.
- `officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` — wired a `household-assign` step after `build`, within the same transaction.

**Tests:** Full suite green — 21 tests, 0 failures (including the new `Cp11Tests` shared-household check and the existing `Cp10Tests` duplicate/allow cases).
